source_scope: Manuscript, review, package and active documentation only.
verification_rule: Before moving main, fetch the constructed tree and require every explicit write to match its locally computed Git blob SHA; require every other base blob and mode to be preserved; require the historical v12 preparation report to equal the old active report. Then use expected_sha on the branch update and read back the new commit.
library_duplication: not applicable to externally git-backed artifacts
relative_link_check: All current and new report/package links resolve in the release tree. The exact historical v12 report retains its original relative links; current reports link to its original path at the base commit.
